description: Get a random joke, optionally filtered by category (e.g., 'general', 'programming') or type ('single' or 'twopart'). Returns joke text, category, and content flags.

category.description: Joke category. One of: Any, Programming, Misc, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas. Defaults to "Any".

safe_mode.description: When true, only return jokes that are flagged safe by JokeAPI. Defaults to true.

type.description: Joke type. One of: single, twopart. Omit to allow either type.

name: get_joke
